description: Test helper class for managing global properties within the OpenMRS project, used to set, verify, and purge global properties during tests.

classes.name: GlobalPropertiesTestHelper
classes.description: A utility class designed to help with testing global properties in OpenMRS by providing methods to set and purge properties.

methods.name: GlobalPropertiesTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with an instance of AdministrationService.

methods.name: setGlobalProperty
methods.description: Sets a global property to a specified value and asserts the change.

methods.name: purgeGlobalProperty
methods.description: Removes a global property if it exists and asserts that it is null after removal.
